title: 746. Cherry Pickup

examples.explanation: Two coordinated forward paths gather five cherries around the thorns.
No pair of thorn-free routes reaches the goal.

hints: Treat the round trip as two walkers stepping from (0,0) to (n-1,n-1) in lockstep, so both take the same number of steps.
State (r1, c1, r2) fixes c2 by steps: c2 = r1 + c1 - r2; keep the best cherries for each reachable triple.
A shared cell contributes its cherry once; unreachable or thorn states stay at negative infinity, and a negative best means answer 0.
